Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Object, sr As Object, dl As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200).Chart
    ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c"))
    ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3))
    ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6))
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
    Case 1
        ch.ChartType = 57
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
    Case 2
        ch.ChartType = 4
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
    Case 3
        ch.ChartType = 65
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
    Case 4
        ch.ChartType = 5
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
    Case 5
        ch.ChartType = -4120
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
    Case 6
        ch.ChartType = -4169
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
    Case 7
        ch.ChartType = 1
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
    Case 8
        ch.ChartType = 52
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
    Case 9
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
    Case 10
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
    Case 11
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.ShowCategoryName = True
    Case 12
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.ShowSeriesName = True
    Case 13
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.ShowValue = False
    Case 14
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.ShowLegendKey = True
    Case 15
        ch.ChartType = 5
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.ShowPercentage = True
    Case 16
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.ShowPercentage = True
    Case 17
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.ShowBubbleSize = True
    Case 18
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.ShowValue = False: dl.ShowCategoryName = False
    Case 19
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.ShowCategoryName = True: dl.ShowSeriesName = True: dl.ShowValue = False
    Case 20
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.Position = xlLabelPositionInsideEnd
    Case 21
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.Position = xlLabelPositionCenter
    Case 22
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.Position = xlLabelPositionInsideBase
    Case 23
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.Position = xlLabelPositionOutsideEnd
    Case 24
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.Position = xlLabelPositionAbove
    Case 25
        ch.ChartType = 4
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.Position = xlLabelPositionAbove
    Case 26
        ch.ChartType = 4
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.Position = xlLabelPositionBelow
    Case 27
        ch.ChartType = 4
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.Position = xlLabelPositionLeft
    Case 28
        ch.ChartType = 4
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.Position = xlLabelPositionRight
    Case 29
        ch.ChartType = 5
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.Position = xlLabelPositionBestFit
    Case 30
        ch.ChartType = 5
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.Position = xlLabelPositionOutsideEnd
    Case 31
        ch.ChartType = 1
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.Position = xlLabelPositionCenter
    Case 32
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.NumberFormat = "0.0"
    Case 33
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.NumberFormat = "0.0": dl.NumberFormatLinked = True
    Case 34
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.NumberFormatLinked = False
    Case 35
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.Separator = "; "
    Case 36
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.ShowCategoryName = True: dl.Separator = "; "
    Case 37
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.Delete
    Case 38
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        sr.HasDataLabels = False
    Case 39
        ch.ChartType = 51
        Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
        sr.HasDataLabels = True
        Set dl = sr.DataLabels
        dl.ShowValue = False: dl.ShowCategoryName = True: sr.HasDataLabels = False: sr.HasDataLabels = True
    End Select
    On Error Resume Next
    Set dl = sr.DataLabels
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & sr.HasDataLabels
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(sr.DataLabels)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.Count
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(dl.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.ShowValue
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.ShowCategoryName
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.ShowSeriesName
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.ShowPercentage
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.ShowLegendKey
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.ShowBubbleSize
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.Position
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.NumberFormat
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.NumberFormatLinked
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.Separator
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.AutoText
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.ShowRange
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.Orientation
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.HorizontalAlignment
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.VerticalAlignment
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.ReadingOrder
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl.Shadow
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(dl(1))
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(dl.Item(2))
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & dl(4).Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Tried = "ok " & Mid(s, 2)
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & s
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 39
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
